    Two-group statistical analysis and plotting

    two_groups_analysis.Rd

    This function performs statistical analysis and generates summary plots (violin, bar, and box plots) for comparisons between two groups. It supports both parametric (t-test) and non-parametric (Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney) tests, and can handle paired data.

    two_groups_analysis(
  value_column,
  grouping_column,
  data,
  bar_queue = NaN,
  x_label = "",
  x_angle = 30,
  y_label = "",
  size = 10,
  bar_size = 0.5,
  parametric = FALSE,
  paired = FALSE,
  bars = "sem",
  bars_size = 1,
  stat_plot_ratio = 0.15,
  y_break = NaN,
  brew_colors = "Dark2"
)

    Arguments

    value_column

    A string. Name of the column containing the numeric values to be analyzed.

    grouping_column

    A string. Name of the column indicating group membership (must contain exactly two unique values).

    data

    A data frame containing the data.

    bar_queue

    Optional character vector. Specifies the desired order of the groups on the x-axis. Must match group names.

    x_label

    A string for the x-axis label. Default is an empty string.

    x_angle

    Numeric. Rotation angle of x-axis labels (in degrees). Default is 30.

    y_label

    A string for the y-axis label. Default is an empty string.

    size

    Numeric. Font size for axis labels. Default is 10.

    bar_size

    Numeric. Width of bars in bar and box plots. Default is 0.5.

    parametric

    Logical. If TRUE, a t-test is performed; if FALSE, a Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney test is used.

    paired

    Logical. Whether to perform a paired test. Applies to both parametric and non-parametric tests.

    bars

    Character. Type of error bars: either "sem" or "sd" for standard error or standard deviation. Default is "sem".

    bars_size

    Numeric. Size (thickness) of error bars. Default is 1.

    stat_plot_ratio

    Numeric between 0 and 1. Proportion of plot height reserved for displaying significance annotations. Default is 0.15.

    y_break

    Optional numeric. Interval for y-axis tick marks. Default is NaN (automatic).

    brew_colors

    Character. RColorBrewer palette name. Default is "Dark2".

    Value

    An S4 object of class two_groups_analysis, containing:

    • violin_plot — Violin plot with overlaid statistics.

    • bar_plot — Bar plot with error bars.

    • box_plot — Box plot with optional statistical annotations.

    • statistic_tests — An S4 object from test_two_groups(), with test details.

    • statistic_data — A summary data frame with group-wise statistics.

    • statistic_txt_resum — Character summary of the statistical test result.

    • avg_FC_results — Output of avg_FC(), representing average fold change results.

    Details

    This function is designed for exploratory visualization and analysis of two-group comparisons. If more than two groups are present in the grouping column, an error is thrown and the user is advised to use multi_groups_analysis.

    Examples

    df <- data.frame(
  group = rep(c("Control", "Treatment"), each = 10),
  value = c(rnorm(10, 5), rnorm(10, 7))
)
result <- two_groups_analysis(value_column = "value", grouping_column = "group", data = df)
#> Error in assign(mname, def, where): cannot add bindings to a locked environment
result@bar_plot  # View bar plot
#> Error: object 'result' not found
result@statistic_txt_resum  # Summary of the statistical test
#> Error: object 'result' not found
